closing: I qualified as a CA in May 2025, I am based in Navi Mumbai and my notice period is 30 days. I would be glad to walk you through any of this on a call.

proof.aop: For a charitable trust's food and garment divisions, I built the annual operating plan from department budgets up and checked each assumption against the previous year's actuals before it went for approval.
proof.var: Separately, I built Power BI budget-vs-actual dashboards for department-wise variance reviews.
proof.var_after_aop: I then built Power BI budget-vs-actual dashboards to review that plan department by department.
proof.ipo: On a pre-IPO project for an industrial and logistics parks platform, I prepared the Ind AS financial statements of the 12 companies it had acquired and worked with a Big 4 team on the consolidation.
proof.mis: On a pre-IPO project, I prepared the MIS and fund-flow reports management used to watch liquidity in the run-up to a ₹2,600 Cr IPO.
proof.mis_after_ipo: On the same project I prepared the MIS and fund-flow reports management used to watch liquidity in the run-up to the ₹2,600 Cr IPO.
proof.fdd: I also worked on the due diligence of a healthcare InsurTech acquisition, where we found about ₹5 Cr of liabilities being moved through a demerger scheme before the sale.
proof.ctl: Before this, in three years of statutory audit (including a ~₹2,400 Cr infrastructure and mining company), I tested internal controls and CARO compliance.
proof.vba: During articleship I also wrote an Excel VBA macro for trial balance reconciliation that saved my audit team 50+ hours a month.
